decisions: Clarify whether the business box is for retail display, ecommerce shipping, subscription, event, or gift use.
Prepare box type, internal dimensions, product weight, quantity range, material direction and artwork status.
Separate branding needs from protective and shipping needs before asking for a quote.
Do not promise fixed price, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, or unverified compliance claims.
